holds.per_share_cash_amount: Source-fit conflict: section 2.02(a) states each Company Stock share converts to $44.50 cash, while assigned corpus subclass is mixed_cash_stock; hold affected consideration fields.
holds.exchange_ratio: Source-fit conflict: section 2.02(a) states $44.50 cash per Company Stock share, while assigned corpus subclass is mixed_cash_stock. Section 2.02(f) addresses Merger Subsidiary stock, not target stock. Do not infer a stock component or its absence.

alternatives.target_termination_fee: Section 11.04(b) provides specified recommendation-change or intentional breach triggers, an acquisition proposal followed by a transaction within 12 months, and superior proposal termination. Section 11.04(c) reimbursement up to $25,000,000 is distinct and credited against the fee under (e); fee payable no more than once.
